method: Editorial shortlist from catalog capabilities and repository examples; not a benchmark ranking. Paths are relative to the repository root. Single source for the chooser; do not duplicate elsewhere.

scenarios.task: Common English people, organizations, and places
scenarios.why: Small local baseline with common pretrained English entity labels.
alternatives: GLiNER when caller-defined types are needed
disqualifiers: Must recognize arbitrary domain labels without training or prompt-defined inference
unknowns: Real-domain recall depends on corpus and model version

scenarios.why: Supply entity labels at inference time without preparing a task-specific training set.
alternatives: Instructor for fixed structured fields with hosted API
Fine-tuned token classifier for stable schema and labeled data
unknowns: Task accuracy, memory, and latency need measurement on target hardware

scenarios.task: Detect and redact common PII locally
scenarios.why: Composable local analyzer and anonymizer pipeline.
alternatives: Rule recognizers for known identifier formats
Domain-specific local NER if evaluated for the target text
disqualifiers: Requires a guarantee that no PII can remain
unknowns: Recall and false-redaction rates on representative, approved test data

scenarios.task: Typed fields from messy short text
start_with: Instructor + Pydantic with an approved provider/model
scenarios.why: Makes output schema explicit and validates returned shape.
alternatives: Local constrained-generation model if data locality requires it
Rules for stable, strongly formatted text
disqualifiers: Cannot send the input to an external service
unknowns: Factual extraction quality, provider data handling, and per-run cost

scenarios.task: Fields from selectable-text PDF with stable layout
scenarios.why: Simple local path for extractable text and constrained layouts.
alternatives: Docling or another catalogued document parser for varied structures
disqualifiers: PDF is image-only or layout varies substantially
unknowns: Generalization across vendors, scans, tables, and rotations

scenarios.task: Scanned or layout-heavy documents, tables, OCR
scenarios.why: These catalog entries address document parsing, OCR, layout, or reading order.
alternatives: Cloud document extraction service where policy permits
disqualifiers: No OCR or model downloads permitted without an approved cloud alternative
unknowns: Language/layout accuracy, compute, license, and table fidelity for the specific corpus
